title: NA40023: Analysis And Design Of Ocean Structures
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

The basic structural elements and loads in ship, offshore and other ocean
engineering structures- Statically indeterminate nature of these structural
elements; Analysis of statically indeterminate structures/structural elements;
Consistent deformation method, Energy method; Matrix method - direct stiffness
approach Matrix method applied to the analysis of offshore platform, ship deck
idealized as grillage and other structures; Unsymmetrical bending of beams;
Shear stress in beam of thin walled open section - shear center- Its
application lure, container ship and floating dock; Design of welded steel
structures; Design of tension member, beam and column; Built-up sections;
Design of base plate and connection
